title: Chronicles of the Grey Fog & The Divine Council
history: Long before the Fifth Epoch, above the boundless spirit world, lies a transcendent domain veiled in endless Grey Fog. At its heart sits a majestic, towering divine palace supported by ancient stone pillars, centered around an immense mottled bronze table surrounded by twenty-two high-backed chairs carved with the symbols of the Major Arcana.
ethos: The Tarot Club was established by The Fool to exchange mystical knowledge, divine formulas, and blasphemy slates under the iron law of Equivalent Exchange. Here, Beyonders cast aside mundane identities to protect humanity from the encroaching madness of the cosmos and the whispers of the Outer Deities.
warning: Prying into deities invites corruption. Acting is not merely imitating—it is digesting. Maintain your anchor, observe the Sacred Laws, and let reverence guide your ascension.
